nodes.label: Yandex.Metrika analytics counter (metrika.js + noscript pixel)
nodes.rationale: Counter script factored out into /metrika.js; noscript pixel fallback included for JS-disabled clients.

nodes.label: index.html preloaded fonts: Golos Text + JetBrains Mono
Static default <title>/description/favicon overridden by applySeo() at runtime
nodes.rationale: Static values serve the very first render / JS-less crawlers; real site-settings values (Admin → SEO) are applied on top via src/theme/seo.js. The favicon link keeps id="site-favicon" to match what applySeo() queries, avoiding a duplicate <link rel="icon">.
